payload.claim: The acceptance criterion requires the retry to pause 'at least 60 seconds', but the only check of the pause value, in test_worktree.py's test_a_seed_whose_fetch_fails_once_is_retried_on_a_cleared_volume (`assert events[1] == ("sleep", worktree._RETRY_PAUSE_S)`), compares the recorded sleep argument against the same module constant it is testing rather than against a literal. No test anywhere pins _RETRY_PAUSE_S as a literal 60 (the 60.0 literals in tests/test_batch.py pin an unrelated RATE_LIMITED wait). Changing _RETRY_PAUSE_S to e.g. 0.001 leaves every test green while violating the stated 60-second minimum, because both sides of the only relevant assertion move together.
